notes.title: Scoring Update
notes.notes:
Adjusted existing scoring system:

New completed levels are counted into the scoring as +10

New completed levels are treated as a multiplier (multiplying the calculated score by n_levels_complete)

Update End Game UI:

Added arrows and plusses to the stat values that needed it

Update Time to not display as a negative value

Added "Not changed" text to Rank if the rank did not change on the leaderboards
